user.title: Connect to Cannalog
user.description: In the Cannalog app open **Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant** and tap **Get pairing code**. Codes expire after 15 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-connect Cannalog
reauth_confirm.description: Cannalog no longer accepts this Home Assistant's token (it was disconnected in the app or replaced). Enter a new pairing code from the Cannalog app.

reconfigure.title: Change Cannalog server
reconfigure.description: Sensor mappings are kept. Leave the pairing code empty to keep the current connection; enter one only if the new server asks you to re-connect.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code is invalid or has expired - get a new one in the Cannalog app.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cannalog server.
error.wrong_account: That code belongs to a different Cannalog account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error - check the Home Assistant log.
error.token_not_accepted: That server doesn't recognise this connection - enter a pairing code from the Cannalog app.

abort.already_configured: This Cannalog account is already connected.

menu_options.map_target: Map sensors / camera / pump to an environment, zone or reservoir

map_target.title: Choose what to map
map_target.description: Pick a Cannalog environment, zone or reservoir. ✓ = already has sensors, a camera or a pump mapped.

sensors_environment.title: Sensors for {target}
sensors_environment.description:
Choose the Home Assistant sensor for each reading. Leave a field empty to not send it. Pick a camera to show its latest snapshot on this environment in the app.

**Lights on / Lights off**: snapshots are only taken between these times (Home Assistant's time zone), so the app keeps the last photo from when the lights were on. Lights off can be after midnight. Leave both empty to take snapshots around the clock.

sensors_zone.title: Sensors for {target}
sensors_zone.description: Choose the Home Assistant sensor for each reading in this zone. Leave a field empty to not send it. Zone readings show on the zone in the app, separate from the environment's own.

sensors_reservoir.title: Sensors for {target}
sensors_reservoir.description:
Choose the Home Assistant sensor for each reading. Leave a field empty to not send it.

**Pump / valve**: the switch that feeds this reservoir's plants. Every time it turns on and back off, Cannalog logs a feed for every plant on this reservoir at the real time, and stops asking "did it run?" for its schedule. **Water per plant per minute** is optional (drippers); leave it empty for ebb & flow or DWC.

settings.title: Upload settings
settings.description: Readings are averaged over each interval and uploaded at the end of it. Camera snapshots are sent at their own interval; Cannalog keeps only the latest one. Set the lights on and off times on each environment to skip snapshots while the lights are off. **Send audio with live video** forwards the camera's microphone while someone has the live view open (off by default: the mic hears whatever is near the camera).

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cannalog server.
abort.auth_failed: Cannalog rejected the token - re-connect the integration.
abort.no_targets: Your Cannalog account has no environments, zones or reservoirs yet - create one in the app first.

error.lights_both: Set both Lights on and Lights off, or leave both empty.
